Generate a benchmark stream with controlled drift

Source: R/dsg_benchmark.R
dsg_stream.Rd

Builds a stream segment by segment. Each character of pattern first induces a drift with dsg_drift() ("-" or "_" none, "v" virtual, "r" real, "c" both, "a" any) and then draws batch_size samples from the resulting concept.

Usage

dsg_stream(source, pattern, batch_size = 500)

Arguments

source

dsg_source object

pattern

Drift pattern, such as "--v--r-".

batch_size

Number of samples per segment.

Value

list with

  • data: data frame with the features, the label y, the segment and the drift code of the segment (0 none, 1 virtual, 2 real, 3 both, as in the reference implementation);

  • segments: one row per segment with the drift type, the concept and the verification statistics;

  • source: the source in its final concept.

Examples

set.seed(3)
stream <- dsg_stream(dsg_sea(), "--v--r", batch_size = 200)
head(stream$data)
#>         x1       x2        x3 y segment drift
#> 1 3.830383 0.290185 2.5192418 0       1     0
#> 2 5.245535 4.662464 0.1638364 1       1     0
#> 3 8.853655 1.666801 3.5478789 1       1     0
#> 4 9.051492 7.012420 7.3198815 1       1     0
#> 5 1.769911 9.263339 9.4843713 1       1     0
#> 6 5.799461 4.700343 1.9476484 1       1     0
stream$segments
#>   segment type drift virtual_state real_state p_value label_change
#> 1       1    -     0             1          2      NA           NA
#> 2       2    -     0             1          2      NA           NA
#> 3       3    v     1             2          2       0           NA
#> 4       4    -     0             2          2      NA           NA
#> 5       5    -     0             2          2      NA           NA
#> 6       6    r     2             2          3      NA        0.148
